tutorial: No FreeCAD wiki tutorial covers ScanRuler's Mesh Tools (Stefan Hermann's / CNC Kitchen's plugin, ported). The model follows the add-on's own guide (scanrulerfc/guides/mesh-tools.md: inspect, islands, cut, holes, smooth, reduce, use) on a block of known size built with Part and meshed with MeshPart as Mesh_to_Part.md / MeshPart_FromShape describe, so every volume has a worked-out answer and no real scan is needed.

boredBlock.note: 24000 - pi x 5^2 x 20; a few mm³ more as a polygon

expected.where: Every answer but mesh_reduce's, mesh_apply_reduced's and mesh_export's was produced by running the handlers in plain Python on this pass (a 12-triangle box as FreeCAD's mesher makes it; the Pin as an 80-sided prism). Nothing ran in FreeCAD.

conventions.session: One scan session from scan_open to the end: run the chunks in order in the same document. Mesh Tools state is the session's, not the document's: FreeCAD's undo does not touch it.
conventions.placeholders: None: no call needs a value from an earlier answer.
conventions.jobs: mesh_inspect, mesh_cut, mesh_cut_preview, mesh_smooth, mesh_offset, mesh_reduce, mesh_shell, mesh_wrap and mesh_trim are declared heavy: outside a batch a call that passes 45 s answers with a job id (job_status { job, wait }); inside a batch they run inline. None should take more than a few seconds on this model.
conventions.tolerances: Volumes after the boolean depend on how FreeCAD tessellates the cylinder at 0.01 mm: the ranges given allow for it.

notCovered: mesh_boolean with a measured element as the solid (needs element_fit on a real cylinder wall: the other ScanRuler agent's family; the document-body path is covered)
mesh_cut / mesh_mirror across an element instead of a coordinate plane (same reason)
mesh_shell thicken on an open surface and mesh_wrap on a mesh with real gaps (bridgedArea above 0): no open or cracked mesh is built here
mesh_trim with region, offset and flip (offset 0.2 with flip: true gave volume 480 in plain Python)
a mesh large enough to answer as a job (the size statements in the descriptions were timed in a Linux container, not on the Mac)
